purpose: Test one previously saved U1 counterexample after adding one-round, mask-only refinement of an already-selected feasible anchor on a multi-anchor interface.

input.single_source_derivation: Exact candidate_sources[38] from the immutable development freeze; all other metadata retained and patient/source counts set to one.

candidate_contract.trigger: A saved topology-passing area-underfill receipt on an already-selected interface with at least two anchors.
candidate_contract.choice_rule: Among selected and freshly nuclei-feasible anchors on that interface, bisect the largest legally bisectable anchor; break ties by stable anchor id.

failure_policy: Any mismatch, timeout, exception, incomplete receipt, or failure to bind the frozen source is HOLD with no retry.
authorization_basis: Codex self-authorized one development-only counterexample after 41 focused tests passed and the prior probe isolated selected multi-anchor quantization as the unhandled mechanism.
